Season/Description/Page/2:
<color=#83C5A9>CAMPAIGNS</color>

Limited-time gameplay cycles featuring new content,
a Battle Pass, and exclusive rewards available only
during the current campaign.
Season/Description/Page/3:
<color=#83C5A9>CAMPAIGN CHARACTER</color>

Created on dedicated campaign servers.
Progress is reset at the start of each new campaign,
while earned rewards remain on your account.
Season/Description/Page/4:
<color=#83C5A9>MODIFIER SYSTEM</color>

Customize the campaign to match your playstyle with
personal modifiers. Global modifiers affect all
players and change at the start of each new campaign.
Season/Description/Page/5:
<color=#83C5A9>BATTLE PASS</color>

Progress through the Battle Pass by completing tasks in
any game mode. Your Battle Pass progress and unlocked rewards
are synchronized across all game modes.

UITutorial/BattlePass1:
Here you'll find Battle Pass rewards.
You can view the unlock requirements for each item.
UITutorial/BattlePass2:
To unlock a reward, you must meet all of its requirements.
Most often, you'll need to find a certain number of documents.
UITutorial/BattlePass3:
Documents are a special Battle Pass currency used to unlock rewards.
Like task items, documents are special items that are visible only to you during a raid.
UITutorial/BattlePass4: Each document includes <color=#83C5A9>a description and information about where it can be found</color>.
UITutorial/BattlePass5:
Classified Documents are the Battle Pass's universal currency.
They can be used in place of any other document type.
UITutorial/BattlePass6: Each game mode has a <color=#83C5A9>daily limit</color> on the number of documents that can be found during a raid.
UITutorial/BattlePass7: Documents can be <color=#83C5A9>exchanged</color> for one another or used to obtain special <color=#83C5A9>Black Division crates</color>.
UITutorial/BattlePass8_l12: Black Division crates are not synchronized between game modes and are only available in the mode where they were obtained.
UITutorial/BattlePass8_l2: The Battle Pass is synchronized across all Escape from Tarkov game modes.
UITutorial/BattlePass8_l4: Unlocked rewards are available in all game modes.
UITutorial/BattlePass8_l6: After the Campaign ends, your game profile is reset, or you reach Prestige:
UITutorial/BattlePass8_l7: All Battle Pass rewards are retained.
